Who We Are
 We’re looking for a talented Full‑Stack Developer with strong expertise in Java and Angular to join our growing engineering team. In this role, you’ll build scalable, high‑quality applications across the entire stack—designing robust backend services in Java while crafting intuitive, responsive user interfaces with Angular. If you enjoy solving complex problems, collaborating in an agile environment, and delivering clean, maintainable code, this opportunity is a great fit.
 What You’ll Be Doing
Develop and maintain backend services using Java, Spring Boot, and RESTful APIsBuild responsive, user‑friendly frontend applications using Angular
Collaborate with product owners, designers, and other engineers to translate requirements into technical solutions
Write clean, maintainable, and well‑tested code across the full stack
Optimize application performance, scalability, and security
Participate in code reviews and contribute to continuous improvement of development practices
Integrate third‑party services, APIs, and internal systems
Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve issues across frontend and backend components
Contribute to architectural decisions and propose technical enhancements
Work within an agile environment, participating in sprint planning, stand‑ups, and retrospectives
 What you’ll bring along
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
Minimum 5–7 years of professional software development experience
Strong hands‑on experience with Java 17 or Java 21, including modern language features
Solid expertise in Spring Boot, including experience with migrations and commonly used Spring starters/frameworks
Proficiency in building responsive, modular front‑end applications using Angular
Good understanding of SQL and relational database concepts
Familiarity with testing methodologies, including unit, integration, and end‑to‑end testing
Experience working with Azure cloud services and Git for version control
Ability to design, develop, and maintain full‑stack solutions in an agile environment
Strong problem‑solving skills and a focus on writing clean, maintainable code
